entry.name: SWARM_STATUS_TAKEOFF
entry.description: Listening, waiting to climb, or climbing.

entry.name: SWARM_STATUS_READY
entry.description: At its hold altitude, no assignment yet.

entry.name: SWARM_STATUS_HOLD
entry.description: Holding at its hold altitude (deaf, nothing to fly, or an infeasible slot).

entry.name: SWARM_STATUS_FAILSAFE
entry.description: The autopilot left GUIDED; the agent no longer controls the vehicle.

message.name: SWARM_STATE
message.description: Agent to all, at STATE_HZ: its own state from its own autopilot.
message.field: Time the position was sampled (UNIX epoch).
Position east of the area origin.
Position north of the area origin.
Epoch of the assignment flown, -1 before the first.
Index of the active slot, -1 without one.

message.name: SWARM_START
message.description: Ground to all, repeated: the mission clock.
message.field: Wall time of mission t = 0 (UNIX epoch).

message.name: SWARM_ASSIGN
message.description: Ground to one agent, repeated at ASSIGN_HZ: its share and ordered goal slots.
message.field: After the last slot, continue from this index.
Slots used in slot_x and slot_y; 0 = hold.
xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax; all 0 with no plan.

message.name: SWARM_INFEASIBLE
message.description: Agent to ground, repeated until a newer epoch: a slot it could not reach in SLOT_TIMEOUT_S.
